summary: An L-4 cab built in 1947 on a Wenatchee National Forest lookout camp first used in 1925, now rented overnight through Recreation.gov.

access.note: Overnight rental via Recreation.gov; reached by Forest Road 5310, 1.5 miles.

visit.trail_note: 1.5 mi on FS Road 5310, snow-free roughly mid-April to mid-November; otherwise foot, ski or snowshoe.

events.note: Site used as a Forest Service lookout camp before the current cab was built
Rental listing says the Forest Service used it until the 1990s
NHLR volunteer visit found it apparently abandoned: broken shutters, power line removed, no sign of recent use
Registered January 3, 2015, nominated by Bob and Susan Adler

evidence.quote: Steliko began as a camp in 1925. The present structure, a 10' L-4 built in 1947, is presently available on the Recreation Rental program.

Wenatchee National Forest
7 miles northwest of Entiat
Chelan County, Washington

evidence.supports: 2011 visit found tower apparently abandoned, needs paint
evidence.quote: seems like Stiliko has been abandoned. Shutters broken but screwed to lookout. No sign of recent use. Power lines removed and abandoned

evidence.supports: volunteer's 2011 note calling for a coat of paint
registered Jan 3 2015, nominated by Bob and Susan Adler

evidence.supports: rangers from Ardenvoir may still use it in high fire danger
evidence.quote: unknown....probably used in high fire danger times by Ardenvoir rangers

evidence.supports: staffed by Forest Service until the 1990s
evidence.quote: Built in 1947, the lookout was used by Forest Service personnel until the 1990’s.

evidence.supports: views toward Tyee Mountain, Stormy Mountain, Waterville Plateau
evidence.quote: Views from the lookout include Tyee Mountain, Stormy Mountain and east to the Waterville Plateau.

evidence.supports: road access via FS Road 5310, 1.5 miles, seasonal
evidence.quote: The route to the lookout follows FS Road 5310 and is 1.5 miles long with 945 feet of elevation gain.

evidence.supports: accessible by SUV/4WD mid-April to mid-November
evidence.quote: The lookout is accessible by SUV or four-wheel drive truck from mid-April to mid-November.

evidence.supports: otherwise reached by foot, ski, snowshoe, snowmobile
evidence.quote: Mid-November – mid-April the lookout is only accessible by walking, skiing, snowshoeing, or snowmobiling the 1.5 miles up the road

evidence.supports: 16x16 cabin sleeps four, foam mattresses, two-burner propane stove
evidence.quote: The 16x16 cabin sleeps four and is equipped with four single foam mattresses, two on regular frames and two on trundle style frames. Two foldable tables, a bench with a two-burner propane stove

evidence.supports: outhouse with vault toilet 40 yards away
evidence.quote: An outhouse with a vault toilet is located 40 yards from the lookout.
Recent upgrades to the building will make your stay comfortable, but are still primitive, guests should be prepared with their own supplies.
As such, visitors should be prepared to stay at the lookout without facility-provided heat.
